# Data Dictionary

<!-- Generated by `fol dictionary --write` from src/front_office/domain/tables. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every table the lab stores, as declared by its data contract. A frame must satisfy
its contract before it is stored, so this document describes what is actually in
the database rather than what was once intended.

## Conventions

- Seasons are labelled by both years: `2025-26`.
- Money is whole US dollars.
- Shares and percentages are fractions between 0 and 1 unless a unit says otherwise.
- Dates and times are UTC.
- Missing text is null, never an empty string.

## Provenance

Each column declares where its values come from. The workbench uses this to keep
measured statistics, modeled estimates and user assumptions visibly apart.

| Provenance | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `identifier` | Keys, names and labels. |
| `measured` | Recorded by the source: box-score counts, official cap figures, signed salaries. |
| `derived` | Deterministic arithmetic on measured values. |
| `modeled` | Output of a statistical model or weighted composite: an estimate, not a fact. |
| `assumption` | Entered or chosen by the user. |
| `operational` | Pipeline bookkeeping: fetch times, run status, versions. |

### teams

The thirty current franchises. A franchise keeps its id when it relocates or is renamed.

- **Grain:** One row per active franchise.
- **Primary key:** `team_id`

| Column | Type | Required | Provenance | Unit | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `team_id` | integer | yes | identifier |  | Franchise id assigned by the league. |
| `abbreviation` | string | yes | identifier |  | Current three-letter abbreviation. |
| `city` | string | yes | identifier |  | Current city or region name. |
| `nickname` | string | yes | identifier |  | Current nickname, e.g. Celtics. |
| `full_name` | string | yes | identifier |  | City and nickname. |
| `conference` | string | yes | identifier |  | Current conference. One of: `East`, `West`. |
| `division` | string | yes | identifier |  | Current division. |
| `first_season_year` | integer | no | measured |  | Calendar year the franchise's first season began. |

### playoff_results

Every playoff series, derived from game results.

- **Grain:** One row per playoff series.
- **Primary key:** `season`, `series_id`
- **Indexes:** `season`, `round`

| Column | Type | Required | Provenance | Unit | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `season` | string | yes | identifier |  | Season label, e.g. 2025-26. |
| `series_id` | string | yes | identifier |  | Series key: season, round and the two team ids. |
| `round` | integer | yes | derived |  | Playoff round, 1 (first round) to 4 (NBA Finals). |
| `round_name` | string | yes | identifier |  | Name of the round. One of: `First Round`, `Conference Semifinals`, `Conference Finals`, `NBA Finals`. |
| `team_a_id` | integer | yes | identifier |  | The team that hosted game 1. References `teams.team_id`. |
| `team_b_id` | integer | yes | identifier |  | The team that visited in game 1. References `teams.team_id`. |
| `team_a_wins` | integer | yes | measured |  | Games won by team A. |
| `team_b_wins` | integer | yes | measured |  | Games won by team B. |
| `games_played` | integer | yes | measured |  | Games played in the series. |
| `best_of` | integer | yes | measured |  | Scheduled length of the series: 5 or 7 games. |
| `is_complete` | boolean | yes | derived |  | Whether one team has won enough games to take the series. |
| `winner_team_id` | integer | no | identifier |  | Series winner. Null while the series is undecided. References `teams.team_id`. |
| `loser_team_id` | integer | no | identifier |  | Series loser. Null while the series is undecided. References `teams.team_id`. |
| `start_date` | date | yes | measured |  | Date of the first game. |
| `end_date` | date | yes | measured |  | Date of the most recent game. |

| `non_taxpayer_mid_level` | integer | no | measured | USD | Non-taxpayer mid-level exception. |
| `taxpayer_mid_level` | integer | no | measured | USD | Taxpayer mid-level exception. |
| `room_mid_level` | integer | no | measured | USD | Mid-level exception for teams with cap room. |
| `bi_annual` | integer | no | measured | USD | Bi-annual exception. |
| `max_salary_0_to_6_years` | integer | no | measured | USD | Maximum first-year salary, 0-6 years of service. |
| `max_salary_7_to_9_years` | integer | no | measured | USD | Maximum first-year salary, 7-9 years of service. |
| `max_salary_10_plus_years` | integer | no | measured | USD | Maximum first-year salary, 10 or more years of service. |
| `max_standard_contracts` | integer | yes | measured | players | Most standard contracts a team may carry in season. |
| `min_standard_contracts` | integer | yes | measured | players | Fewest standard contracts a team must generally carry. |
| `max_two_way_contracts` | integer | yes | measured | players | Most two-way contracts a team may carry. |
| `offseason_max_players` | integer | yes | measured | players | Most players a team may have under contract in the offseason. |
| `source_urls` | string | yes | operational |  | Where the figures were verified; one URL per line. |
| `rules_version` | string | yes | operational |  | Fingerprint of the figures, recorded with anything computed from them. |

### contracts

Player salary agreements as supplied in an imported contract file: one row for each run of consecutive seasons a team owes a player.

- **Grain:** One row per player per team per run of consecutive seasons.
- **Primary key:** `contract_id`
- **Indexes:** `player_id`; `team_id`

| Column | Type | Required | Provenance | Unit | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `contract_id` | string | yes | identifier |  | Key built from player, team, first season and status. |
| `player_id` | integer | yes | identifier |  | Player id. References `players.player_id`. |
| `team_id` | integer | no | identifier |  | Team that owes the salary. Null if the file gave no team. References `teams.team_id`. |
| `player_name` | string | yes | identifier |  | Player name as written in the contract file. |
| `contract_type` | string | yes | identifier |  | Standard contracts count against the roster limit of fifteen; two-way contracts have their own limit and do not count against the cap. One of: `standard`, `two_way`. |
| `status` | string | yes | identifier |  | Active: the player is under contract. Dead money: salary still owed to a player who was waived. One of: `active`, `dead_money`. |
| `first_season` | string | yes | identifier |  | First season the file lists salary for. |
| `last_season` | string | yes | identifier |  | Last season the file lists salary for. |
| `seasons` | integer | yes | measured | seasons | Number of seasons listed. |
| `total_salary` | integer | yes | derived | USD | Sum of the listed seasons' salaries. |
| `guaranteed_amount` | integer | no | measured | USD | Total guaranteed money, as the file states it. Null if not stated. |
| `source_label` | string | yes | operational |  | Where the person who supplied the file got the figures. |
| `as_of_date` | date | yes | operational |  | Date the figures were current, as stated at import. |

### contract_years

Salary for each season of each contract, with its share of that season's cap.

- **Grain:** One row per contract per season.
- **Primary key:** `contract_id`, `season`
- **Indexes:** `season`, `team_id`; `player_id`, `season`

| Column | Type | Required | Provenance | Unit | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `contract_id` | string | yes | identifier |  | The contract this season belongs to. References `contracts.contract_id`. |
| `season` | string | yes | identifier |  | Season label, e.g. 2025-26. |
| `player_id` | integer | yes | identifier |  | Player id. References `players.player_id`. |
| `team_id` | integer | no | identifier |  | Team that owes the salary. References `teams.team_id`. |
| `salary` | integer | yes | measured | USD | Salary for the season. |
| `salary_cap_pct` | float | no | derived | fraction | Salary as a fraction of that season's cap. Null when the season's cap is not configured, as for future seasons the league has not set. |
| `option` | string | no | identifier |  | Option attached to the season, if any. One of: `player`, `team`, `early_termination`. |
| `guarantee` | string | no | identifier |  | How much of the season's salary is guaranteed. Null if the file does not say. One of: `full`, `partial`, `none`. |
| `years_remaining` | integer | yes | derived | seasons | Seasons left on the contract after this one. |

### player_value_scores

The value model's estimate of each player in each regular season: what the season showed, what was expected going into it, and what both are worth in wins. A row for a season the player has not played holds the projection alone.

- **Grain:** One row per player per season.
- **Primary key:** `player_id`, `season`
- **Indexes:** `season`

| Column | Type | Required | Provenance | Unit | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `player_id` | integer | yes | identifier |  | Player id. References `players.player_id`. |
| `season` | string | yes | identifier |  | Season label, e.g. 2025-26. |
| `model_version` | string | yes | operational |  | Revision of the fitted value model that produced the row. |
| `age` | integer | no | derived | years | Age in the season: as published if the player appeared, otherwise carried forward from the last season played. |
| `minutes_share` | float | no | derived | fraction | Minutes played as a share of the team's game minutes, added up over every team played for: 1 is every minute of every game. |
| `reliability` | float | no | derived | fraction | Share of the season's estimate that rests on the player's own numbers; the rest is what is assumed of any player used that much. |
| `impact` | float | no | modeled | points per 100 possessions | Estimated effect on a team's net rating while on the court, against the league's average minute, from this season alone. |
| `impact_offense` | float | no | modeled | points per 100 possessions | The part of impact that is points added on offense. |
| `impact_defense` | float | no | modeled | points per 100 possessions | The part of impact that is points saved on defense. |
| `impact_from_efficiency` | float | no | modeled | points per 100 possessions | The part of impact that comes from scoring efficiency. |
| `impact_from_creation` | float | no | modeled | points per 100 possessions | The part of impact that comes from creation: scoring attempts, assists and free throws. |
| `impact_from_shooting` | float | no | modeled | points per 100 possessions | The part of impact that comes from spacing: three-point attempts. |
| `impact_from_rebounding` | float | no | modeled | points per 100 possessions | The part of impact that comes from rebounding. |
| `impact_from_ball_security` | float | no | modeled | points per 100 possessions | The part of impact that comes from ball security: turnovers. |
| `impact_from_defensive_activity` | float | no | modeled | points per 100 possessions | The part of impact that comes from defensive activity: steals, blocks and fouls. |
| `impact_from_on_court` | float | no | modeled | points per 100 possessions | The part of impact that comes from the team's results with the player on the court. |
| `impact_from_team_context` | float | no | modeled | points per 100 possessions | The part of impact that comes from the results of the teams played for. |
| `impact_from_baseline` | float | no | modeled | points per 100 possessions | The part of impact that is assumed rather than shown: the level given to the share of the estimate the minutes do not vouch for, less the constant that puts the league's average minute at zero. |
| `wins_added` | float | no | modeled | wins | Wins the season was worth over a replacement player in the same minutes. |
| `projected_impact` | float | no | modeled | points per 100 possessions | Impact expected going into the season, from the seasons before it and age. |
| `projected_offense` | float | no | modeled | points per 100 possessions | The offensive part of projected impact. |
| `projected_defense` | float | no | modeled | points per 100 possessions | The defensive part of projected impact. |
| `projection_reliability` | float | no | derived | fraction | Share of the projection that rests on the player's own earlier numbers. Null for a player with no earlier season. |
| `projection_seasons` | integer | yes | derived |  | Earlier seasons the projection draws on; 0 for a player with none. |
| `projected_share` | float | no | modeled | fraction | Share of team minutes expected going into the season. |
| `projected_wins` | float | no | modeled | wins | Wins over a replacement player expected going into the season, over 82 games. |

### player_archetypes

Each player's score for each role in each regular season, by the rules in configs/archetypes.yaml: the weakest of the player's percentiles on the role's measures, among the players the role is open to. A rule, not a measurement.

- **Grain:** One row per player per season per archetype the player is open to.
- **Primary key:** `player_id`, `season`, `archetype`
- **Indexes:** `season`, `archetype`

| Column | Type | Required | Provenance | Unit | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `player_id` | integer | yes | identifier |  | Player id. References `players.player_id`. |
| `season` | string | yes | identifier |  | Season label, e.g. 2025-26. |
| `archetype` | string | yes | identifier |  | Key of the archetype, as configured. |
| `score` | float | yes | modeled | percentile | The weakest of the player's percentiles on the archetype's measures. |
| `fills` | boolean | yes | modeled |  | Whether the score reaches the archetype's cut-off, a convention set in configuration. |
| `is_primary` | boolean | yes | modeled |  | Whether, of the roles the player fills that season, this has the highest score. |
| `archetype_version` | string | yes | operational |  | Version of the archetype definitions that produced the row. |

### team_fit_profiles

What each team's players added up to in a regular season, in the roadmap's areas of fit: role coverage, shooting, defense, the possession battle, structure, depth and usage, each player weighted by the minutes played for the team. The reference a built roster is placed among.

- **Grain:** One row per team per regular season with player statistics.
- **Primary key:** `season`, `team_id`

| Column | Type | Required | Provenance | Unit | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `season` | string | yes | identifier |  | Season label, e.g. 2025-26. |
| `team_id` | integer | yes | identifier |  | Team id. References `teams.team_id`. |
| `archetype_version` | string | yes | operational |  | Version of the archetype definitions the role counts come from. |
| `model_version` | string | no | operational |  | Version of the value model the impacts come from; missing when none was fitted. |
| `players` | integer | yes | derived |  | Players who played a minute for the team in the season. |
| `primary_creators` | float | no | modeled | players | Players in the rotation who fill the primary creator role. |
| `creators` | float | no | modeled | players | Players in the rotation who fill the primary or the secondary creator role. |
| `spacers` | float | no | modeled | players | Players in the rotation who fill the floor spacer role. |
| `three_point_rate` | float | no | modeled | per 100 possessions | Minutes-weighted average of the players' three-point attempts per 100 possessions on the court. |
| `three_point_accuracy` | float | no | modeled | share | Minutes-weighted average of the players' three-point percentage with league-average attempts mixed in, so that a few hot nights do not make a shooter. |
| `free_throw_rate` | float | no | modeled | share | Minutes-weighted average of the players' free-throw attempts per field-goal attempt: the nearest a box score comes to pressure on the rim. |
| `assist_rate` | float | no | modeled | share | Minutes-weighted average of the players' share of teammates' baskets assisted while on the court. |
| `offense_sum` | float | no | modeled | points per 100 possessions | The players' offensive impacts added up for the minutes given: the points per 100 possessions a team would gain on offense if its players simply added up. |
| `perimeter_defenders` | float | no | modeled | players | Players in the rotation who fill the perimeter defender role. |
| `switchable_wings` | float | no | modeled | players | Players in the rotation who fill the switchable wing role. |
| `rim_protectors` | float | no | modeled | players | Players in the rotation who fill the rim protector role. |
| `steal_rate` | float | no | modeled | per 100 possessions | Minutes-weighted average of the players' steals per 100 possessions on the court. |
| `block_rate` | float | no | modeled | per 100 possessions | Minutes-weighted average of the players' blocks per 100 possessions on the court. |
| `defense_sum` | float | no | modeled | points per 100 possessions | The players' defensive impacts added up for the minutes given: the points per 100 possessions a team would save if its players simply added up. |
| `rebound_rate` | float | no | modeled | share | Minutes-weighted average of the players' share of available rebounds taken while on the court. |
| `turnover_rate` | float | no | modeled | share | Minutes-weighted average of the players' turnovers per play used. |
| `height` | float | no | modeled | inches | Average listed height in inches, each player weighted by minutes. |
| `guard_minutes` | float | no | modeled | share | Share of the minutes played by players listed at guard, alone or with another position. |
| `wing_minutes` | float | no | modeled | share | Share of the minutes played by players of wing size listed at forward or at guard-forward. Guards and big men of that size are not wings here. |
| `big_minutes` | float | no | modeled | share | Share of the minutes played by players listed at center or standing 6'11" and taller. |
| `multi_position` | float | no | modeled | share | Share of the minutes played by players listed at two positions: the nearest the listings come to positional flexibility. Athleticism is not in the data at all. |
| `bench_impact` | float | no | modeled | points per 100 possessions | Minutes-weighted average impact of the sixth to tenth players by minutes. |
| `bench_creators` | float | no | modeled | players | Players among the sixth to tenth by minutes who fill a creator role. |
| `bench_bigs` | float | no | modeled | players | Players among the sixth to tenth by minutes who are big men. |
| `bench_defenders` | float | no | modeled | players | Players among the sixth to tenth by minutes who fill a defensive role: perimeter defender, switchable wing or rim protector. |
| `unprofiled_share` | float | no | modeled | share | Share of the minutes played by players with no statistics to build a profile from: in a real season, newcomers to the league. |
| `star_share` | float | no | modeled | share | The top player's wins above replacement as a share of the rotation's, counting only players above replacement. The higher, the more rests on one player staying fit. |
| `usage_sum` | float | no | modeled | share | Five times the minutes-weighted average usage rate: what the players' usage adds up to with five of them on the court. A real team's adds up to 100%. A roster assembled from several teams can ask for more plays than a game has, or fewer. |
| `usage_top` | float | no | modeled | share | The three highest usage rates in the rotation added up: how much of the offense three players are used to running. |
| `impact_sum` | float | no | modeled | points per 100 possessions | The players' impacts added up for the minutes given: the net rating, relative to the league, a team would have if its players simply added up. |
| `projected_sum` | float | no | modeled | points per 100 possessions | The same with each player's projection going into the season instead of what the season showed. |
| `minutes_covered` | float | no | modeled | share | The players' minutes as a share of the minutes a team has to fill in the season. |

### custom_rosters

Rosters assembled by the user in the Team Builder.

- **Grain:** One row per roster.
- **Primary key:** `roster_id`

| Column | Type | Required | Provenance | Unit | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `roster_id` | integer | yes | identifier |  | Roster id, assigned when the roster is created. |
| `name` | string | yes | assumption |  | Name the user gave the roster. |
| `stats_season` | string | yes | assumption |  | Season whose statistics describe the players. |
| `payroll_season` | string | yes | assumption |  | Season whose salaries and cap the roster is priced against. |
| `notes` | string | no | assumption |  | The user's notes. |
| `created_at` | datetime | yes | operational |  | When the roster was created. |
| `updated_at` | datetime | yes | operational |  | When the roster or its players last changed. |

### roster_players

The players on each user-built roster.

- **Grain:** One row per player per roster.
- **Primary key:** `roster_id`, `player_id`
- **Indexes:** `player_id`

| Column | Type | Required | Provenance | Unit | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `roster_id` | integer | yes | identifier |  | The roster. References `custom_rosters.roster_id`. |
| `player_id` | integer | yes | identifier |  | Player id. References `players.player_id`. |
| `slot` | string | yes | assumption |  | Where the user placed the player: a starting position or the bench. One of: `PG`, `SG`, `SF`, `PF`, `C`, `BENCH`. |
| `assumed_salary` | integer | no | assumption | USD | A salary the user entered for this player, used in place of contract data. Null means use the contract data. |
| `added_at` | datetime | yes | operational |  | When the player was added. |

### fetch_log

Every attempt to fetch a dataset from a source, successful or not.

- **Grain:** One row per fetch attempt.
- **Primary key:** `fetch_id`
- **Indexes:** `source`, `dataset`; `finished_at`

| Column | Type | Required | Provenance | Unit | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `fetch_id` | integer | yes | operational |  | Attempt id, assigned when recorded. |
| `source` | string | yes | operational |  | Source the dataset comes from. |
| `dataset` | string | yes | operational |  | Dataset requested. |
| `partition_key` | string | yes | operational |  | Which slice of the dataset: season, season type, team. |
| `season` | string | no | operational |  | Season requested, if the dataset is seasonal. |
| `status` | string | yes | operational |  | What happened. One of: `stored`, `unchanged`, `failed`. |
| `rows` | integer | no | operational |  | Rows returned. |
| `error` | string | no | operational |  | Why the attempt failed. |
| `started_at` | datetime | yes | operational |  | When the attempt began. |
| `finished_at` | datetime | yes | operational |  | When the attempt ended. |

### builds

Every rebuild of the database from the raw store.

- **Primary key:** `build_id`

| Column | Type | Required | Provenance | Unit | Description |

| `build_id` | integer | yes | operational |  | Build id, assigned when recorded. |
| `started_at` | datetime | yes | operational |  | When the build began. |
| `finished_at` | datetime | yes | operational |  | When the build ended. |
| `lab_version` | string | yes | operational |  | Version of the lab that ran the build. |
| `schema_fingerprint` | string | yes | operational |  | Fingerprint of the table contracts the build used. |
| `status` | string | yes | operational |  | Whether the build was clean. One of: `ok`, `problems`. |

| `build_notes` | integer | yes | operational |  | Adjustments made to source data. |
| `check_errors` | integer | yes | operational |  | Quality checks that found a contradiction. |
| `check_warnings` | integer | yes | operational |  | Quality checks that raised a warning. |

| `dataset` | string | yes | operational |  | Dataset. |
| `partition_key` | string | yes | operational |  | Which slice of the dataset: season, season type, team. |
